svg.title: First Iradi Civil War, 1992
svg.desc: Areas held at the start of the war in March 1992, the SRI offensive and siege of Talas, the US airlift, and the joint advance along the railway to Kobozev. Areas follow the ground: the SRI on the low land along the railway and round Kobozev, the Provisional Government on the floor of the Talas valley, the clans in the mountains to the south. Border of Irad: Kartalar map data. Relief: SRTM via the AWS Terrain Tiles (public domain). Base map: Natural Earth (public domain). Chu, Talas and Chatkal rivers © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
